title: Ukraine Peace Talks Resume in Abu Dhabi
summary:
Negotiators from Ukraine, Russia, and the United States have started new talks in Abu Dhabi about ending the war in Ukraine. Few people expect a big breakthrough, but American officials said both sides were privately showing 'a little bit of flexibility' about who would control Ukraine's eastern regions after the war.

Jared Kushner, Donald Trump's son-in-law and part of the American team, said the talks would focus on the safety worries of both Russia and Ukraine after the war.

The biggest problem is Donetsk, a region in eastern Ukraine now mostly controlled by Russia. Moscow has asked Ukraine to give up the parts it still holds, while Kyiv wants to freeze the front line and keep those areas, which it says are key to its safety in the future.

Neither side has moved, but an American official said the problem cannot be solved without first agreeing on a new plan for safety after the war. The last round of talks, in Geneva in February, ended without a breakthrough. European leaders, who have mostly been left out, want to take part.
why_it_matters: It matters because wars hurt families and children, and peace talks are how grown-ups try to bring the fighting to an end.
